external.definition: provider consensus label; historical Q2 matches adjusted EPS; future exact basis and constituent cutoff not established

expectations.reason: provider disagreement and missing basis/cutoff; public guide bridge already near larger estimate

calculation_limits: EPS bridges use constant guide inputs, not incremental profit forecasts, annualization, price targets or probabilities. CFO sensitivity is not normalized FCF. Warrant stress is conditional maximum, not present diluted EPS denominator.
financial_resilience: June liquidity and cash generation support ability to execute through a short window, but June balance is stale; 2026 debt maturity and large supplier/customer/lease commitments require updated roll-forward. No claim current free cash is 13.111bn.
rejection_reasons: Known dated result is not mispricing; guide EPS bridge approximately 1.93 versus provider 1.94.
September management already disclosed large 2027 growth and slightly lower margin during MI450 ramp.
No current executable quote, verified valuation/ownership bridge, or defensible residual edge after delayed reading.
Conditional warrants, floating acquisition share issuance and strategic investment/leases affect per-share economics.

delay_assessment.hours: First repricing can occur after-hours before a verified executable refresh; headline beat alone insufficient.
delay_assessment.one_to_three_days: Possible later reassessment of persistent margin/volume/cash revisions, only at refreshed price and complete guidance; no claim drift advantage exists.
delay_assessment.correct_but_late: Good fundamentals can already be fully reflected after gap; cancel thesis price case rather than chase.

next_evidence: Read Q3 complete results, Q4 guidance and transcript, comparing September baseline.
Refresh executable bid/ask, FX/costs and exact ISA instrument before any decision.
Reconcile September 2026 debt maturity, actual liquid balances, supplier commitments and customer-investment cash flows.
Model incremental volume/mix/margin, capex and dilution with contrary customer/competitor primary evidence.
Obtain contemporaneous comparable estimate definitions/cutoffs and residual price requirements; if unavailable retain rejection.
